title: ALIGNING AI WITH SHARED HUMAN VALUES
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark explicitly avoids measuring aspects of religion. The dataset's datasheet (Appendix D.3) states it does not contain data that reveals religious beliefs, as it is designed to focus on uncontroversial and widely shared moral judgments.
findings: The paper's primary finding related to religion is its explicit exclusion from the ETHICS benchmark. The authors deliberately avoided sensitive topics, including religious beliefs, to focus on creating a dataset of unambiguous, widely-shared moral scenarios that would have high agreement across different groups.
